name: MemoryProvenance
description:
MemoryProvenance records which agent proposed a memory and in which
 conversation.

fields.name: AgentId
fields.description: ID of the agent that proposed this memory.

fields.name: SessionId
fields.description: ID of the session in which this memory was proposed.

fields.name: AgentRunId
fields.description: ID of the agent run in which this memory was proposed.

fields.name: ToolCallId
fields.description: ID of the remember tool call that proposed this memory.
